entities.summary: Nikolai Alexandrovich Engelhardt was a Russian writer, critic, poet, journalist, memoirist and literary historian, co-founder and one of the original leaders of the Russian Assembly. The writer and agricultural scientist Alexander Engelgardt was his father.
